overrides.name: Agony the Ghost
overrides.appearanceSource: Light of Xaryxis and related tiefling artwork from Spelljammer
overrides.subjectPrompt: The ghost of a mutinous tiefling sailor aboard a fantasy space galleon. One lean androgynous adult tiefling spirit with two swept-back weathered horns, peaked ears, long dark wind-loosened hair, a crooked sardonic smile and pale luminous lavender eyes. Historically plausible worn maritime clothes: loose linen shirt, worn dark aubergine short sailor's coat with a copper clasp, dark breeches, a knotted sash and a short frayed belt rope. Ghostly smoky blue-plum tint, softly fading edges on feet, coat hems and slim pointed tail, with the fully visible head and torso crisp and well defined. Float gently above a faint ground shadow, one open hand slightly raised as if addressing a crew. No hat, no armor, no weapons. The second reference only establishes tiefling anatomy and local clothing vocabulary; create an entirely separate character.
overrides.style: The Lost Hope square gouache and sepia parchment
